nodes.name: Resource protection & threat
nodes.description: Fundamental system for protecting accumulated resources and responding to threat and loss. Seed L1 children: loss aversion, scarcity.

nodes.name: Reward & anticipation
nodes.description: Reward, its anticipation and learning; the exploratory drive toward expected value. Seed L1 children: variable reward, curiosity gap.

nodes.name: Goals & completion
nodes.description: Goal pursuit, progress tracking, and the pull of unfinished business. Seed L1 children: habit loop, progress & incompleteness.

nodes.name: Social standing
nodes.description: Affiliation, status, and comparison among peers as motivational forces. Seed L1 children: status & comparison, social proof, reciprocity.

nodes.name: Self & ownership
nodes.description: Self-image, identity, and the sense of ownership over things and outcomes. Seed L1 children: endowment effect, identity & consistency.

nodes.name: Evaluation & choice
nodes.description: How options are evaluated and decisions are made relative to presentation and reference points. Seed L1 child: framing & anchoring.

nodes.name: Perception & comprehension

anchors.rdoc: Cognitive systems — attention, perception, working memory

nodes.description: How information is perceived, processed and understood before any motivational mechanism can operate: attention allocation, cognitive load, modality (image vs text), processing fluency, scanning behaviour.

nodes.name: Interaction & agency

anchors.rdoc: Cognitive systems — cognitive control; Positive valence — reward responsiveness

nodes.description: How it feels to operate the product: perceived competence and control, responsiveness and feedback, recovery from error, effort and defaults, flow, and the aesthetic-usability relationship.
